Specification: This module proves auxiliary lemmas about the graph reachability operator ReachableFrom defined in the imported module Reachability. The lemmas characterize basic properties of reachability from a set of nodes, including that every node in a starting set is reachable, that adding successors of a node already in the set does not change the reachable set, and that the reachable set from the empty set is empty. The file is proof-oriented rather than algorithmic: it contains TLAPS-checked hierarchical proofs, uses induction over natural numbers via NaturalsInduction, and establishes facts used in the correctness proof of the algorithm in module Reachable.
TheoremNames:
Reachable0 ==
       \A S \in SUBSET Nodes : 
           \A n \in S : n \in ReachableFrom(S)

Reachable1 == 
        \A S, T \in SUBSET Nodes : 
          (\A n \in S : Succ[n] \subseteq (S \cup T))
            => (S \cup ReachableFrom(T)) = ReachableFrom(S \cup T)

Reachable2 == 
            \A S \in SUBSET Nodes: \A n \in S : 
                 /\ ReachableFrom(S) = ReachableFrom(S \cup Succ[n])
                 /\ n \in ReachableFrom(S)
AssumeProveBlocks:
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes,
                      NEW n \in S
               PROVE  n \in ReachableFrom(S)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes, NEW T \in SUBSET Nodes,
                      \A n \in S : Succ[n] \subseteq (S \cup T)
               PROVE  (S \cup ReachableFrom(T)) = ReachableFrom(S \cup T)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW n \in ReachableFrom(S)
                 PROVE  n \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in S, NEW q \in Nodes,
                            NEW p \in Seq(Nodes),
                            /\ IsPathFromTo(p,m,q)
                            /\ Len(p) = 0+1
                     PROVE  q \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)

ASSUME NEW i \in Nat, R(i)
            PROVE  R(i+1)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in S, NEW q \in Nodes,
                            NEW p \in Seq(Nodes),
                            /\ IsPathFromTo(p,m,q)
                            /\ Len(p) = (i+1)+1
                     PROVE  q \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes,
                      NEW n \in S
               PROVE  /\ ReachableFrom(S) = ReachableFrom(S \cup Succ[n])
                      /\ n \in ReachableFrom(S)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in Succ[n], NEW o \in Nodes,
                          ExistsPath(m, o)
                   PROVE  ExistsPath(n, o)
